verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 36.11
verses.english: Linked Discourses 36.11

verses.pali: 2. Rahogatavagga
verses.english: 2. In Private

verses.pali: Rahogatasutta
verses.english: In Private

verses.pali: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then a mendicant went up to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and said to him:

verses.pali: “idha mayhaṁ, bhante, rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṁ cetaso parivitakko udapādi—
verses.english: “Just now, sir, as I was in private retreat this thought came to mind.

verses.pali: tisso vedanā vuttā bhagavatā.
verses.english: The Buddha has spoken of three feelings.

verses.pali: Sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā—
verses.english: Pleasant, painful, and neutral feeling.

verses.pali: imā tisso vedanā vuttā bhagavatā.
verses.english: These are the three feelings the Buddha has spoken of.

verses.pali: Vuttaṁ kho panetaṁ bhagavatā:
verses.english: But the Buddha has also said:

verses.pali: ‘yaṁ kiñci vedayitaṁ taṁ dukkhasmin’ti.
verses.english: ‘Suffering includes whatever is felt.’

verses.pali: Kiṁ nu kho etaṁ bhagavatā sandhāya bhāsitaṁ:
verses.english: What was the Buddha referring to when he said this?”

verses.pali: ‘yaṁ kiñci vedayitaṁ taṁ dukkhasmin’”ti?
“Sādhu sādhu, bhikkhu.
verses.english: “Good, good, mendicant!

verses.pali: Tisso imā, bhikkhu, vedanā vuttā mayā.
verses.english: I have spoken of these three feelings.

verses.pali: Sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā—
verses.english: Pleasant, painful, and neutral feeling.

verses.pali: imā tisso vedanā vuttā mayā.
verses.english: These are the three feelings I have spoken of.

verses.pali: Vuttaṁ kho panetaṁ, bhikkhu, mayā:
verses.english: But I have also said:

verses.pali: ‘yaṁ kiñci vedayitaṁ, taṁ dukkhasmin’ti.
verses.english: ‘Suffering includes whatever is felt.’

verses.pali: Taṁ kho panetaṁ, bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhārānaṁyeva aniccataṁ sandhāya bhāsitaṁ:
verses.english: When I said this I was referring to the impermanence of conditions, to the fact that conditions are

verses.pali: ‘yaṁ kiñci vedayitaṁ taṁ dukkhasmin’ti.
Taṁ kho panetaṁ, bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhārānaṁyeva khayadhammataṁ …pe…
verses.english: liable to end,

verses.pali: vayadhammataṁ …pe…
verses.english: vanish,

verses.pali: virāgadhammataṁ …pe…
verses.english: fade away,

verses.pali: nirodhadhammataṁ …pe…
verses.english: cease,

verses.pali: vipariṇāmadhammataṁ sandhāya bhāsitaṁ:
verses.english: and perish.

verses.pali: ‘yaṁ kiñci vedayitaṁ taṁ dukkhasmin’ti.
Atha kho pana, bhikkhu, mayā anupubbasaṅkhārānaṁ nirodho akkhāto.
verses.english: But I have also explained the progressive cessation of activities.

verses.pali: Paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ samāpannassa vācā niruddhā hoti.
verses.english: For someone who has attained the first absorption, speech has ceased.

verses.pali: Dutiyaṁ jhānaṁ samāpannassa vitakkavicārā niruddhā honti.
verses.english: For someone who has attained the second absorption, the placing of the mind and keeping it connected have ceased.

verses.pali: Tatiyaṁ jhānaṁ samāpannassa pīti niruddhā hoti.
verses.english: For someone who has attained the third absorption, rapture has ceased.

verses.pali: Catutthaṁ jhānaṁ samāpannassa assāsapassāsā niruddhā honti.
verses.english: For someone who has attained the fourth absorption, breathing has ceased.

verses.pali: Ākāsānañcāyatanaṁ samāpannassa rūpasaññā niruddhā hoti.
verses.english: For someone who has attained the dimension of infinite space, the perception of form has ceased.

verses.pali: Viññāṇañcāyatanaṁ samāpannassa ākāsānañcāyatanasaññā niruddhā hoti.
verses.english: For someone who has attained the dimension of infinite consciousness, the perception of the dimension of infinite space has ceased.

verses.pali: Ākiñcaññāyatanaṁ samāpannassa viññāṇañcāyatanasaññā niruddhā hoti.
verses.english: For someone who has attained the dimension of nothingness, the perception of the dimension of infinite consciousness has ceased.

verses.pali: Nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṁ samāpannassa ākiñcaññāyatanasaññā niruddhā hoti.
verses.english: For someone who has attained the dimension of neither perception nor non-perception, the perception of the dimension of nothingness has ceased.

verses.pali: Saññāvedayitanirodhaṁ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca niruddhā honti.
verses.english: For someone who has attained the cessation of perception and feeling, perception and feeling have ceased.

verses.pali: Khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo niruddho hoti, doso niruddho hoti, moho niruddho hoti.
verses.english: For a mendicant who has ended the defilements, greed, hate, and delusion have ceased.

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhu, mayā anupubbasaṅkhārānaṁ vūpasamo akkhāto.
verses.english: And I have also explained the progressive settling of activities.

verses.pali: Paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ samāpannassa vācā vūpasantā hoti.
verses.english: For someone who has attained the first absorption, speech has stilled.

verses.pali: Dutiyaṁ jhānaṁ samāpannassa vitakkavicārā vūpasantā honti …pe…
verses.english: For someone who has attained the second absorption, the placing of the mind and keeping it connected have stilled. …

verses.pali: saññāvedayitanirodhaṁ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca vūpasantā honti.
verses.english: For someone who has attained the cessation of perception and feeling, perception and feeling have stilled.

verses.pali: Khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo vūpasanto hoti, doso vūpasanto hoti, moho vūpasanto hoti.
verses.english: For a mendicant who has ended the defilements, greed, hate, and delusion have stilled.

verses.pali: Chayimā, bhikkhu, passaddhiyo.
verses.english: There are these six levels of tranquility.

verses.pali: Paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ samāpannassa vācā paṭippassaddhā hoti.
verses.english: For someone who has attained the first absorption, speech has been tranquilized.

verses.pali: Dutiyaṁ jhānaṁ samāpannassa vitakkavicārā paṭippassaddhā honti.
verses.english: For someone who has attained the second absorption, the placing of the mind and keeping it connected have been tranquilized.

verses.pali: Tatiyaṁ jhānaṁ samāpannassa pīti paṭippassaddhā hoti.
verses.english: For someone who has attained the third absorption, rapture has been tranquilized.

verses.pali: Catutthaṁ jhānaṁ samāpannassa assāsapassāsā paṭippassaddhā honti.
verses.english: For someone who has attained the fourth absorption, breathing has been tranquilized.

verses.pali: Saññāvedayitanirodhaṁ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca paṭippassaddhā honti.
verses.english: For someone who has attained the cessation of perception and feeling, perception and feeling have been tranquilized.

verses.pali: Khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo paṭippassaddho hoti, doso paṭippassaddho hoti, moho paṭippassaddho hotī”ti.
verses.english: For a mendicant who has ended the defilements, greed, hate, and delusion have been tranquilized.”

verses.pali: Paṭhamaṁ.
